Nina: Quick update — promoted to Director of Research this morning! :tada: Felt surreal but excited.
Alex: Huge congrats Nina!! Director suits you. Drinks later? :beers: 
Sam: CONGRATS NINA!!! People Ops, cake? :cake:
Rae: Also, completely unrelated but major plot twist — Alex just asked Sam to marry them in the kitchen. I was there, it was adorable. :heart_eyes: :ring:
Owen: Wait what?!?! Did I miss this live?? Pics or it didn't happen.
Alex: It did happen. Sam said yes. I brought flowers and an embarrassingly long speech.
Sam: Yes!! I said yes! surprised and very happy. Also I accepted the flowers and the office applause like a true professional. :blush:
People Ops Bot: @nina congrats on the promotion! I created a 20-min celebration at 3:30pm in the kitchen with a GF cake option and an option to add a card for the group gift. RSVP here: https://forms.company/celebrate-nina (reminder at 3:00pm). @alex and @sam congrats on the engagement! Would you like a small engagement cake at 3:45pm? Please fill this: https://forms.company/engagement (auto-reminder at 3:15pm).
Lilly: I brought my camera. If people want photos for slide decks / future morale presentations, I got shots. :camera_with_flash:
Theo: Two celebrations in one thread. We should make this a special episode of "Watercooler Wins." :podium: 
Nina: Wow, thank you all  overwhelmed in the best way. I'll be around for the mini celebration. Congrats Alex & Sam  wedding planning tips will be doled out freely.
Alex: Thanks everyone. Full disclosure: I was practicing the proposal line in the mirror for two weeks. Worth it.
Sam: Also shoutout to Rae for being the accomplice and making sure everything was ready. Big thanks.
Owen: Poll: cake flavor? React :one: for chocolate, :two: for lemon, :three: for vanilla.
Rae: :three: vanilla for the win. It won't steal focus from the happy chaos.
Lilly: I'll upload photos to the #random-pics folder after the party.
People Ops Bot: Event reminders scheduled. Congrats again to everyone involved!
